adoption: No default change based on this one-case pilot. No success-selected retries or new tasks; retain every failed or budget-unexecuted case.
authorization: User: 同时比对下这三种方案吧. Use only the retained CNY3.888119 allowance; no additional funds.
budget_rule: Before each actual submission, reserve (exact HTTP body UTF-8 bytes + 1024)*12 + 12288*36 microunits. Stop before submission if unavailable. Successful bounded usage at frozen uncached rates releases unused reserve; delivery/envelope failure debits reserve. No retry. This is conservative authorization accounting, not a provider balance.
comparison_scope: Extraction stage only. Full is the unmodified current record request/schema. Focused removes auxiliary record obligations; staged uses an unverified complete-binding inventory followed by the identical focused schema/request plus that inventory. No reviewers, repair, voting, answer sharing between schemes or candidate scope calls. All receive identical source and frozen template. No full-chain or deployability claim for projected results.
config_change: Use 12288 instead of preceding 8192 completion cap for every stage, retaining 4096 thinking budget; prior truncation motivates equal headroom. Fresh baseline means no old output is substituted.
evaluation: For each fixed item score content, direct target/scope and structural guard separately; complete_binding requires all three. Independently editable atom is a separate score: a composite may preserve meaning yet fail Atomic readiness. Code labels/IDs/ordering and equivalent legitimate topology do not determine correctness. Conditions in prose do not supply structural event guards. Omitted or unresolvable bindings count as missing/unresolved, not correct. List unsupported extra assertions and effective system/user presentation conflicts separately. No graph-wide pass for projected outputs.
fairness: Same model/snapshot, temperature, top_p, seed, thinking budget, completion ceiling, source-first delivery, native JSON schema and schema-in-system delivery. A/B one call; C two calls. Report the extra resources, not an equal-cost causal comparison. Reduced schemas and instructions form a workload package; this is not an isolated length ablation.
objective: Compare full records, focused complete bindings and inventory-then-focused-bindings on the same exposed pandoc task; distinguish binding errors, coverage, grain, delivery failures, cost and within-configuration repeat variation.
rate_source: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen3-7-max; same frozen uncached upper rates verified 2026-09-16
repetition_rule: Separate calls with identical settings including seed; compare semantic error patterns, not IDs or text identity. Two repeats on one task are descriptive and cannot establish variance or transfer accuracy.
